D: After Santa is kidnapped, the head of North Pole security teams up with a hacker to get him back.
P: Serve the snacks when the search for Santa begins.
S: MORA command centre loaded potato skins
Crisp potato skins with cheddar, bacon, sour cream and chilli honey

Crispy twice-baked potato skins loaded with cheddar, bacon and spring onion, topped with sour cream, pickled jalapeño and hot honey. Prick 6 medium potatoes and bake at 200C for 1 hour. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins inside and out with 30g melted butter and salt. Bake skin-side up for 10 minutes, then flip. Fill with 150g grated cheddar and 4 rashers chopped cooked bacon and bake 8 minutes until melted. Top with 150g sour cream, sliced spring onion, pickled jalapeños and a drizzle of 2 tbsp honey mixed with 1 tsp chilli flakes.
Maple roasted pecans, almonds and pretzels with chocolate and cranberries

Maple-glazed pecans and almonds roasted with pretzels and cinnamon, tossed with dark chocolate chunks and dried cranberries. Toss 150g pecans and 100g almonds with 3 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray with 100g mini pretzels and roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely so the glaze crisps. Toss with 100g chopped dark chocolate and 80g dried cranberries and tip into a big bowl.
M: Red One's training day steak plate
Grilled rump, parsley chimichurri, sweet potato wedges, broccolini

Chargrilled rump with chimichurri, smoky sweet potato wedges and charred broccolini, a high protein dinner for a very fit Santa. Cut 2 large sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with 2 tbsp oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt, and roast at 220C for 30 minutes. Blitz 1 bunch parsley, 2 garlic cloves, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Season 800g rump steak and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes and slice. Grill 2 bunches broccolini for 4 minutes. Spoon chimichurri over the steak.
W: Red cocoa cookies with white chocolate, rolled in icing sugar

Soft, fudgy red velvet cookies rolled in icing sugar so they crack as they bake, with white chocolate chunks inside. Beat 115g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, then add 1 egg, 1 tbsp milk, 1 tsp vanilla and 1 tsp red colouring paste. Mix in 200g plain flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt, then fold in 100g chopped white chocolate. Chill 1 hour. Roll into 16 balls, roll each in 60g icing sugar and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool on the tray.
K: Hot chocolate with cinnamon, brown sugar and a pinch of chilli

Dark hot chocolate with cinnamon, a pinch of chilli and vanilla, topped with whipped cream and grated chocolate. Heat 1L full cream milk with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 cinnamon stick and a pinch of chilli powder until steaming. Remove the cinnamon and whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate, 50g milk chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 mugs and top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and a little grated chocolate.

dishes.n: MORA command centre loaded potato skins

Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp and brown.

Top with sour cream, spring onion and jalapenos, and drizzle with honey mixed with chilli flakes.

Blitz the parsley, garlic, chilli, vinegar and olive oil into chimichurri.
Season the steak and grill over high heat, then rest and slice.
Grill the broccolini.
Spoon the chimichurri over the steak and serve with the wedges and broccolini.

veg.n: Red One's training day haloumi plate

ingredients.item: large sweet potatoes, cut into wedges

steps.text: Toss the sweet potato with the vegetable oil, paprika and salt and roast at 220C.
Blitz the parsley, garlic, chilli, vinegar and olive oil into chimichurri.
Grill the haloumi over high heat for 2 minutes a side until charred.
Grill the broccolini.
Spoon the chimichurri over the haloumi and serve with the wedges and broccolini.
